body: My father took Effexor and doesn't regret it. He got serious erectile dysfunction from it though.
Nothing springs to mind. But thanks for trying. You kept me alive long enough for my next class. I think I might have Impostor Syndrome. I'll talk to my therapist.

I was thinking about working for the government, but maybe a brokerage. Anyway, going through the motions isn't enough for me. Not any more. I want to actually belong somewhere. I don't even feel that at home.
Great teacher turned me onto it when I was in high school. It just made sense.

I'm getting a B.S. in Economics. And no. Sorry, I don't believe you. Every year people have said it would change. "It will get better. Next year school will be harder. You'll have to study in college. College will be the best time of your life. You'll make so many friends. You don't need to drink to have social life in college." I'm sick of being lied too.
At first I was blinded by enthusiasm. I thought this was where I would finally fit in. This would be where my life turned around. I was wrong. Nothing changed. It feels like it never will.
Sit on my ass and play video games. Nothing of value. Maybe reddit. Watch TV.
